purpose: Teach: 盛り込ま/所定/同月/両側/過大/前々/附属/米ドル

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 企画書に新機能を盛り込まないとね
lines.en: We need to work new features into the proposal.
lines.style: Measured, businesslike clarity. Direct opening. Steady pace, collaborative — not demanding. Slight upward lilt on the end, inviting agreement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。所定の手続きを徹底します
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure we follow protocol carefully.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive. Slight nod in the voice. Steady, not rushed. The tone of someone ready to deliver, taking the directive seriously without being stiff.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 同月内のキャンペーンを準備しましょう
lines.en: Let's prepare the campaign materials for this month.
lines.style: Organized, forward-moving. Calm authority without pressure. Even pace, matter-of-fact. Opens with quiet intention — this is what comes next.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。店舗の両側に新ポスターを貼ります
lines.en: I'll get new posters put up on both sides of the storefront.
lines.style: Confirming and precise. Light, practical energy. Quick but not terse. The reassurance of someone already mentally executing the task.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 過大評価しすぎないようにしましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure we're not overselling this.
lines.style: Gentle caution underneath. Warm but grounded — she's checking their expectations. Slight pause before the second part, like choosing careful words.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。前々からのお客様を大切にします
lines.en: I'll keep focusing on the customers we've built relationships with over time.
lines.style: Earnest, protective undertone. Steady and genuine. The voice of someone who understands what matters. Slow enough to feel intentional, not rushed.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 大学附属機関との合同イベントを企画しましょう
lines.en: Let's plan a joint event with the university's affiliated research center.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly ambitious. Opening with quiet confidence. Measured pace. The tone of expanding scope deliberately, not recklessly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。米ドル決済のオプションを追加します
lines.en: I'll add USD payment options to our system.
lines.style: Clear, definitive close. Professional finality without coldness. Brief, assured. The last note of a solid plan coming together.
